author: KEXP
description: Chilean singer-songwriter Javiera Electra explores queer resilience through a blend of art-pop, rock, and cumbia. In her full Live on KEXP session in Bilbao, she shares a performance of “El tiempo y la distancia entregan mucho más de lo que yo podría” and more. Watch the full session on our channel and subscribe for more music discovery.
title: Javiera Electra Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
